instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside an indoor gym with gray padded walls, the man in the blue tank top (R1) stands on the left, facing right. The bearded man in the maroon t-shirt (R2) stands on the right, facing left. They engage in sparring, with R1 extending his arms to grip R2's forearms while R2 holds his hands up defensively. Bright overhead lighting casts soft shadows on the gray floor.

R2 keeps his hands raised defensively while R1 grips his forearms
R1 is the active forearm-grabber rather than R2
